description: This file defines a React component for a console tab in a trace viewer, including the data model, rendering logic, and formatting functions for console entries displayed in the UI.

methods.name: useConsoleTabModel
methods.description: React hook that creates and filters the console entries model based on trace data and selected time boundaries.

methods.name: ConsoleTab
methods.description: React functional component that renders the console entries list with formatting, including error/warning indicators and timestamps.
